method: Python tarfile USTAR in sorted relative path order; mode0644 uid/gid0 empty owner names mtime0; gzip level9 filename empty mtime0. Exact original bytes; no JSON reserialization.
verification: Read every member back from the finished archive and check relative path, regular-file type, byte length and SHA-256 against originals before unlinking only the explicitly listed duplicate expanded files.
expanded_files_retained: session.json, report.json, manifest.json, all event files, failure records, input projections/source notes, command evidence and scripts.
deletion_scope: Only the explicitly listed checks/final-*/*-report.json duplicate CLI replay receipts; authoritative runs/*/report.json and current-summary files stay expanded.
